## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are **signed** (`git commit -S`)
- [ ] No agent attribution in commits/PR (no `Co-Authored-By`, no "Generated with …")
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] `ruff check` / `ruff format --check` / `mypy` / `pytest` pass
- [ ] Significant decisions captured as an ADR in `docs/architecture/adr/`
- [ ] No third-party documentation committed (corpora stay local)
